years_since_diagnosis.evidence: diagnosed with Crohn's five years ago

location.evidence: Colonoscopy showed Crohn's in my ileum and cecum

severity.evidence: Failed mesalamine and prednisone, developed pancreatitis on azathioprine, moved to biologics; currently stable on Humira with mini-flares — suggests moderate disease requiring biologic therapy but not severe/uncontrolled

disease_control.evidence: Been stable on Humira for two years now, though I still have mini-flares during my period

treatments.evidence: Started with conventional therapy - mesalamine and brief prednisone. Helped initially, but symptoms returned within months.

treatments.reason_stopped: Developed pancreatitis, spent a week in the hospital
treatments.evidence: Tried immunomodulators next, azathioprine specifically. Developed pancreatitis, a rare but serious side effect, spent a week in the hospital.

treatments.reason_stopped: infusion center was an hour away, taking too much time off work every 8 weeks
treatments.evidence: Started Remicade, but the infusion center was an hour away, and taking that much time off work every 8 weeks was difficult.

encounters.evidence: doctors kept dismissing my symptoms as period-related or stress
Finally, a female GI doctor took me seriously and ordered proper testing. Colonoscopy showed Crohn's in my ileum and cecum. Started with conventional therapy - mesalamine and brief prednisone.
Developed pancreatitis, a rare but serious side effect, spent a week in the hospital.
That's when we moved to biologics. Started Remicade... Switched to Humira... GI doctor says many women do it successfully

status.evidence: Switched to Humira for the convenience of home injections. Been stable on Humira for two years now.

barriers.evidence: Failed mesalamine, prednisone, and azathioprine (stopped due to pancreatitis) before moving to biologics
Insurance covers the Humira through a specialty pharmacy, but the prior authorization process every year is a nightmare. Always worried they'll deny it.
Switched from Remicade to Humira because infusion center was an hour away and taking time off work every 8 weeks was difficult
The injection anxiety is real - I have to psyche myself up for 20 minutes before each dose.

referral_steps_gp_to_prescriber.evidence: GP/dismissive doctors (step 1) -> GI specialist who diagnosed and eventually prescribed biologics (step 2)
